description: Architecture rules for BOME backend - Enforces clean architecture patterns

rules.name: No cross-braid imports in handlers
rules.description: Handlers in one braid cannot import from another braid's packages
rules.rationale: Braids should be independent. Handlers should only use shared services, not other braids.

rules.name: Handlers must use services through ports
rules.description: Handlers should depend on service interfaces (ports), not concrete implementations
rules.rationale: Dependency Inversion Principle - depend on abstractions, not concretions.

rules.name: Use cases cannot import HTTP packages
rules.description: Use cases are pure business logic and should not depend on HTTP/Gin
rules.rationale: Use cases should be protocol-agnostic and testable without HTTP.

rules.name: Models cannot import services
rules.description: Models/repositories should not depend on business services
rules.rationale: Data layer should be independent of business logic layer.

rules.name: Shared services must be domain-organized
rules.description: All shared services should be organized under their domain directory
rules.rationale: Discoverability and maintainability - services grouped by domain.

rules.name: Services must have port interfaces
rules.description: Each service domain should have a ports.go file defining interfaces

rules.name: Infrastructure only in infrastructure package
rules.description: Database, config, and infrastructure code should be in infrastructure package
rules.rationale: Infrastructure concerns should be abstracted and centralized.

rules.name: Respect layering hierarchy
rules.description: Lower layers cannot import from higher layers
rules.rationale: Prevents circular dependencies and maintains clean architecture.

rules.name: Use case tests should be pure
rules.description: Use case tests should not require HTTP server or database
rules.rationale: Use case tests should be fast and isolated.

rules.name: Use case naming convention
rules.description: Use cases should be named as verbs (RegisterUser, LoginUser, etc.)
rules.rationale: Consistent naming improves readability and discoverability.

rules.name: No circular dependencies
rules.description: Packages cannot have circular import dependencies
rules.rationale: Circular dependencies indicate poor architecture and cause compilation issues.

exceptions.reason: Test files may need to import test helpers from other braids
Infrastructure package itself can use raw database libraries
